title: eludite.editor.find input
description: Find in a document (Edit > Find and Replace > Quick Find, Ctrl+F). Without a query, opens the find bar. With a query, selects the next match after the caret, wrapping at the end.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

case_sensitive.description: Match case (Alt+C in the find bar). Default false.
